q: Polonium-210 ${}^{210}_{84}\text{Po}$ decays by alpha decay. Write the decay equation.
a: ${}^{210}_{84}\text{Po} \to {}^{206}_{82}\text{Pb} + {}^{4}_{2}\text{He}$. The mass number is conserved ($210 = 206 + 4$) and the charge number is conserved ($84 = 82 + 2$); the atomic number $82$ is lead.

q: How many protons and how many neutrons are there in a carbon-14 nucleus ${}^{14}_{6}\text{C}$, and what makes it an isotope of carbon?
a: There are $Z = 6$ protons and $N = A - Z = 14 - 6 = 8$ neutrons. It is carbon because it has six protons like all carbon nuclei; isotopes differ only in the number of neutrons.
